tokens.name: cc-navy
tokens.usage: Brand navy for the wordmark and logo, the reversed-logo tile, and the "Paradigm" footer mark in the sidebar. 12.6:1 on white.

tokens.name: cc-navy-700
tokens.usage: Darker step of the brand navy.

tokens.name: cc-navy-900
tokens.usage: Darkest step of the brand navy.

tokens.name: blue-25
tokens.usage: Sidebar background and tinted callout cards (via `bg-brand-subtle`).

tokens.name: blue-200
tokens.usage: Borders for brand badges and tinted callouts.

tokens.name: blue-300
tokens.usage: Light step of the brand blue ramp.

tokens.name: blue-400
tokens.usage: Focus ring (`ring-focus`) on buttons, links, cards and checkboxes. 3.82:1 on white, so it meets the 3:1 rule for focus rings and borders only, not text. Fields use a `blue-600` ring instead.

tokens.name: blue-600
tokens.usage: Primary action color: primary buttons, the on toggle, checked checkboxes and radios, progress bars. White text on it is 5.46:1.

tokens.name: blue-700
tokens.usage: Primary button hover and the active sidebar icon.

tokens.name: blue-800
tokens.usage: Link text (`cc-link`) and brand badge text. 8.35:1 on white, 7.83:1 on `blue-50`.

tokens.name: gray-50
tokens.usage: External client canvas (`bg-secondary`), table header rows, disabled inputs, secondary-button hover, neutral badge fill.

tokens.name: gray-100
tokens.usage: Hover fill for tertiary and icon buttons, disabled-button fill, progress track (`bg-tertiary`). Not a page background: inputs (2.91:1) and tertiary text (4.18:1) fail on it.

tokens.name: gray-200
tokens.usage: Hairlines for cards, table rows and dividers (`border-primary`).

tokens.name: gray-300
tokens.usage: Card borders, secondary-button and disabled-input borders (`border-strong`). Decorative only at 1.44:1, so never use it alone to show state or to outline an active field or an empty checkbox.

tokens.name: gray-400
tokens.usage: Disabled text, decorative empty-state icons (`fg-quaternary`) and the interactive-card hover border. 2.47:1 on white, so never use it for text people need to read.

tokens.name: gray-500
tokens.usage: Placeholders, captions, icon buttons (`fg-tertiary`), and unchecked checkbox, radio and off-toggle boundaries. 4.56:1 on white, but 4.37:1 on `gray-50`, so use only large text or icons there.

tokens.name: gray-600
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and tertiary-button text (`fg-secondary`). 7.14:1 on white.

tokens.name: gray-700
tokens.usage: Labels, table cells, secondary-button and neutral badge text. 9.46:1 on white.

tokens.name: gray-800
tokens.usage: Hover text for secondary and tertiary buttons and muted links; inline code text.

tokens.name: gray-900
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings (`fg-primary`). 16.88:1 on white.

tokens.name: gray-950
tokens.usage: Ink for shadows, as rgba(10, 13, 18, …). Overlays use their own tokens built on it: `overlay-backdrop`, `overlay-icon` and `overlay-icon-hover`.

tokens.name: success-500
tokens.usage: Success dots and icons beside a text label. 2.76:1 on white, so it can't carry meaning alone.

tokens.name: success-800
tokens.usage: Hover for green (success) buttons, such as Validate and ScholarRecord on the validation page; their resting color is `success-700`. White text on it is 7.96:1. Not for text or status: use `success-700`.

tokens.name: warning-500
tokens.usage: Warning dots and icons beside a text label. 2.35:1 on white, so it can't carry meaning alone.

tokens.name: error-500
tokens.usage: Invalid-input border and error dots (3.76:1 on white). Not for text, and not behind white text.

tokens.name: error-700
tokens.usage: Error text, error hints, and the destructive-button fill behind white text. 6.57:1 on white.

tokens.name: bg-primary
tokens.usage: Internal admin canvas, cards, inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: External client canvas, including the Student Store. Inputs (`border-input`, 3.04:1) pass on it; use `fg-secondary` for text directly on it.

tokens.name: bg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Subtle filled surfaces and hover fills. Never a page background.

tokens.name: fg-primary
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `bg-primary` and `bg-secondary`.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and hints on `bg-primary` and `bg-secondary` (7.14:1 on white, 6.84:1 on `gray-50`). Also the text color for captions and sub-text on `gray-50` and on tinted selected states, where `fg-tertiary` fails.

tokens.name: fg-tertiary
tokens.usage: Captions and placeholders on `bg-primary` (white) only, 4.56:1. On `bg-secondary` (`gray-50`, 4.37:1) or a tinted selected background (such as `blue-50`, 4.28:1) use `fg-secondary` instead.

tokens.name: fg-quaternary
tokens.usage: Disabled text and decorative icons only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, disabled inputs, checkboxes and code boxes, secondary buttons and stronger separators.

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Border of active text fields (`cc-input`) in default and filled states (#8C9199). 3.17:1 on white and 3.04:1 on `gray-50`, so it meets 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). Fails on `gray-100` (2.91:1), so keep inputs on white or `gray-50`. Disabled inputs use `border-strong`. Also the unchecked checkbox border (1.5px) and code-entry boxes.

tokens.name: overlay-backdrop
tokens.usage: Scrim behind every dialog and drawer, image viewers included (`gray-950` at 70%, the Untitled UI modal value). Flat, no backdrop blur.

tokens.name: overlay-icon
tokens.usage: Icon circles on images, such as the expand icon on credential previews (`gray-950` at 60%). White icons on it are 5.1:1 even over a white image. Never go lighter for the default state.

tokens.name: overlay-icon-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and focus state of `overlay-icon` circles (`gray-950` at 75%). White icons on it are 8.9:1 over a white image.

styles.name: text-sm
styles.usage: UI default: buttons, inputs, labels and table cells.

styles.name: text-xs
styles.usage: Badges, captions, table headers and sub-lines.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: xs button and input side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: md button side padding; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: lg button side padding; card padding.

tokens.name: shadow-xs
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, buttons and badges. Covers about 90% of elevation.

tokens.name: shadow-3xl
tokens.usage: Modals that need the most lift.

tokens.name: shadow-button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary and destructive buttons: drop shadow plus an inset 1px edge.

tokens.name: shadow-button-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary buttons: drop shadow plus an inset bottom "weight".

tokens.name: ring-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on buttons, links, cards and checkboxes: 2px `blue-400`, 3.82:1 on white and 3.66:1 on `gray-50`. Fields (inputs, selects, dropdowns, code boxes) keep their 1px edge and add a tight 2px `blue-600` ring instead (`error-500` when the field has an error), matching the developed store.

tokens.name: fw-medium
tokens.usage: UI text: buttons, labels, badges and table headers.

tokens.name: fw-bold
tokens.usage: Card heading rows and metric numbers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toast region, above `z-modal` so a status message is never hidden behind a dialog.
